name: Shadowless
detailed_description:
WARNING: This video game may cause seizures in people with photosensitive epilepsy. Players are advised to exercise caution.

Shadowless is a first-person psychological horror game.

Explore a mysterious, ever-changing house in a slow-paced, atmospheric world that combines an extraordinarily soothing and eerily realistic environment for a truly terrifying experience.

Environment

The game takes place in a house where terrible things have happened. You'll wander through gloomy corridors, explore every mysterious room, get lost in endless mazes and your head will be filled with memories of events that once took place in the house. This twisted environment, devoid of any life other than your own, will take you to places you could never have imagined.

Storyline

This house is marked by a terrible past. Families have been murdered, people have gone mad, many have committed suicide and other horrific events have occurred. Each room has its own story painted on an invisible canvas. As a player, you will experience parts of this dark past and every shred of it will leave you unsettled and horrified. Soon you will wish you could join the ranks of the dead in their abyss, but death will not help you leave this place. Will you run from it, or will you try to uncover the truth that lies behind the shadows?

Dark Entities

The families that have died in the house will haunt you and leave you uneasy. They will watch your every move, observe you from every corner, play with your mind and try to attack you. Why do they haunt you? What have you done? You'll have to find out for yourself.

Gameplay

In the game you are defenseless; no weapons can save you from the terrible entities that chase you from the next corner, next door or from under your feet. You'll be able to pick up key elements, interact with the environment, and search for things that can help you escape this nightmare or draw you deeper into it.

content_descriptors.notes:
Shadowless is a psychological horror game strictly intended for adult audiences. It includes strong depictions of violence, psychological breakdown, suicide, murder, blood, phobias, and supernatural elements. The audio-visual experience may trigger intense stress, anxiety, or disorientation. Some scenes contain flashing lights and sudden effects that may be harmful to individuals with photosensitive epilepsy.

This game is not suitable for children or teenagers and is strictly recommended for players aged 18 and above. By playing this game, users acknowledge that the content may negatively affect their mental well-being. The developer does not assume responsibility for emotional or psychological discomfort resulting from playing the game. Each player is responsible for evaluating whether this experience is appropriate for them.

If you experience severe stress, panic attacks, anxiety, or any form of emotional distress while playing, we strongly advise you to stop and seek professional psychological or medical assistance.
